people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
translations.bsb: I, Daniel, was grieved in my spirit, and the visions in my mind alarmed me.
translations.kjv: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled
translations.asv: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
